Split question: the evidence points to Clear Fork being a SEPARATE campground from Iron Creek (2298). Each has its own entrance road straight off CO 92 (Clear Fork's loop at ~38.6797,-107.5970 by the Clear Fork Road junction; Iron Creek's at ~38.6723,-107.5981, ~0.8 km south along the highway); their site centroids are ~690 m apart, a little under the ~1 km guide. CPW names them as two campgrounds.
Pin 38.6797,-107.5965 is ~100 m from the RV-site centroid (38.6796,-107.5977); fine.
